title: BPPV: Dix-Hallpike, the Epley Manoeuvre and When Not to Treat

hook.en: The room spins for thirty seconds every time the patient rolls over in bed. Loose crystals in one canal cause it, and five head positions can put them back. Watch the crystal move.
hook.ur: Mareez jab bistar par palatta hai to tees second ke liye kamra ghoomta hai. Ek canal mein dheelay crystals wajah hain, aur sir ki paanch positions unhein wapas laa sakti hain. Crystal ko hilta dekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll recognise BPPV from the story, perform and interpret a Dix-Hallpike test, explain the Epley step by step with the crystal's path, and know when the dizziness is NOT BPPV.
goal.ur: End tak aap kahani se BPPV pehchanenge, Dix-Hallpike test karenge aur samjhenge, Epley ko crystal ke raaste ke saath qadam ba qadam samjhayenge, aur jaanenge ke chakkar kab BPPV NAHI hai.

text.en: Inside each inner ear are three **semicircular canals**, loops of fluid that sense head rotation. Tiny calcium crystals (**otoconia**) normally live in the utricle next door. In **benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV)** some break loose and drift into a canal, most often the **posterior canal** because it is the lowest part when we lie down. Now every time the head moves into a certain position, the crystals roll, drag the fluid and make the brain think the head is spinning when it is not. The vertigo is brief (under a minute) and always triggered by position.
text.ur: Har andaruni kaan mein teen **semicircular canals** hain, fluid ke loops jo sar ki ghoomti harkat sense karte hain. Chhote calcium crystals (**otoconia**) aam taur par saath wale utricle mein rehte hain. **Benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV)** mein kuch toot kar kisi canal mein aa jate hain, aksar **posterior canal** mein kyunke litane par yeh sab se neecha hissa hota hai. Ab jab bhi sar kisi khaas position mein jata hai, crystals lurakte hain, fluid ko kheenchte hain aur dimagh ko lagta hai sar ghoom raha hai jabke aisa nahi. Chakkar mukhtasar (ek minute se kam) aur hamesha position se trigger hota hai.

text.en: Imagine a **marble inside a loop of garden hose** filled with water, with a pressure sensor at one end. Hold the hose still and nothing happens. Tilt it and the marble rolls, pushing the water past the sensor, which screams "movement!" even though your hand barely moved. The Epley manoeuvre is simply the series of tilts that rolls the marble round the loop and out through the exit into a quiet side pocket (the utricle).
text.ur: **Pani se bhare garden hose ke loop mein ek goli** tasawwur karein, aur ek sirey par pressure sensor. Hose ko saakit rakhein to kuch nahi hota. Usay tirchha karein to goli lurakti hai, pani ko sensor ke paas se dhakelti hai, aur sensor chilla uthta hai "harkat!" jabke aap ka haath mushkil se hila. Epley manoeuvre bas tirchhay karne ki woh silsila hai jo goli ko loop mein ghuma kar bahar nikalti hai, ek khamosh side pocket (utricle) mein.

intro.en: Choose the affected ear, then step through the five positions. Watch the amber crystal travel around the posterior canal toward the common opening and drop into the vestibule. The small figure shows the patient's position and the red arrow shows where gravity is pulling. Switch the ear and read how the head-turn directions flip.
intro.ur: Mutasir kaan chunein, phir paanch positions mein qadam ba qadam jayein. Amber crystal ko posterior canal mein common opening ki taraf ghoomte aur vestibule mein girte dekhein. Chhoti figure patient ki position aur laal teer gravity ki khinchai dikhata hai. Kaan badal kar dekhein ke sar ghumane ki simtein kaise ulat jati hain.

question.ur: Kaunsi kahani BPPV se sab se zyada milti hai?

text.en: Constant spinning for two days with nausea, worse with any movement
text.ur: Do din tak musalsal chakkar aur matli, har harkat se zyada

feedback.en: Continuous vertigo for days suggests vestibular neuritis, not BPPV.
feedback.ur: Kai din ka musalsal chakkar vestibular neuritis batata hai, BPPV nahi.

text.en: Sudden vertigo with double vision and trouble speaking
text.ur: Achanak chakkar, double vision aur bolne mein mushkil

feedback.en: That points to a central (brainstem) cause, which needs emergency review.
feedback.ur: Yeh central (brainstem) wajah dikhata hai, jis ka emergency review chahiye.

text.en: Spinning for about 20 seconds when rolling over in bed or looking up, normal when still
text.ur: Bistar par palatne ya upar dekhne par taqreeban 20 second chakkar, saakit hone par theek

feedback.en: Yes — brief, position-triggered spinning with nothing between episodes is classic BPPV.
feedback.ur: Haan — mukhtasar, position se trigger hone wala chakkar aur beech mein kuch nahi, yeh classic BPPV hai.

text.en: **The Dix-Hallpike test finds the canal.** Sit the patient on the bed, turn the head 45° toward the ear being tested, then quickly lie them back with the head hanging about 20° below the bed, and watch the eyes for up to a minute. A **positive** test for the posterior canal gives vertigo and a characteristic **nystagmus**: it starts after a short delay (a few seconds), beats upward and twists (torsional) with the top of the eye turning toward the undermost ear, builds up, then fades within a minute. Sit the patient up and the nystagmus may reverse. Repeat the test and it **fatigues**: it is weaker the second time.
text.ur: **Dix-Hallpike test canal dhoondta hai.** Patient ko bed par baithayein, sar 45° test ho rahe kaan ki taraf ghumayein, phir jaldi se litayein aur sar bed se taqreeban 20° neechay latkayein, aur ek minute tak aankhein dekhein. Posterior canal ke liye **positive** test chakkar aur khaas **nystagmus** deta hai: thori der (kuch seconds) baad shuru, upar ki taraf jhatka aur ghoomta (torsional) hua, aankh ka upri hissa sab se neechay wale kaan ki taraf, barhta hai aur ek minute ke andar khatam. Baithayein to nystagmus ulat sakta hai. Test dobara karein to woh **thak jata hai**: doosri baar kamzor.

question.en: During a Dix-Hallpike test the eyes beat DOWNWARD, start instantly, do not fade and the patient also has a new unsteady gait. What do you conclude?
question.ur: Dix-Hallpike test mein aankhein NEECHAY ki taraf jhatke leti hain, foran shuru hotay hain, khatam nahi hotay aur mareez ki chaal bhi nayi larkhadati hai. Aap kya natija nikalte hain?

text.en: A central cause is likely: do not treat, refer urgently
text.ur: Central wajah mumkin hai: ilaaj na karein, foran refer karein

feedback.en: Yes — downbeating nystagmus without latency or fatigue, with an unsteady gait, breaks the BPPV rules and points to the brainstem or cerebellum.
feedback.ur: Haan — bina latency ya fatigue ke neechay wala nystagmus aur larkhadati chaal BPPV ke usool tod deti hain aur brainstem ya cerebellum ki taraf ishara karti hain.

text.en: A posterior-canal BPPV, so go ahead with the Epley manoeuvre
text.ur: Posterior-canal BPPV hai, is liye Epley manoeuvre kar dein

feedback.en: Posterior canal BPPV gives UPBEATING and twisting nystagmus with a delay and fatigue. This pattern does not fit.
feedback.ur: Posterior canal BPPV mein UPAR jhatka lene wala aur ghoomta nystagmus, delay aur fatigue ke saath hota hai. Yeh pattern nahi milta.

text.en: A normal test; the patient is anxious
text.ur: Test normal hai; mareez ghabrayi hui hai

feedback.en: Downbeating nystagmus is never "normal". Anxiety does not cause it.
feedback.ur: Neechay wala nystagmus kabhi "normal" nahi. Ghabrahat se nahi hota.

hint.en: BPPV nystagmus is upbeating and twisting, with a delay, and fades.
hint.ur: BPPV ka nystagmus upar jhatka lene wala aur ghoomta hai, delay ke saath, aur khatam ho jata hai.

title.en: Three kinds of "dizzy" that need different answers
title.ur: Teen qism ke "chakkar" jin ke jawab alag hain

rows.en: Brief spinning (under a minute) on rolling over, looking up or bending; fine when still
rows.ur: Mukhtasar (ek minute se kam) chakkar palatne, upar dekhne ya jhukne par; saakit hone par theek

rows.en: Positive Dix-Hallpike (upbeating-torsional, delay, fatigues): treat with the Epley manoeuvre
rows.ur: Positive Dix-Hallpike (upbeating-torsional, delay, fatigue): Epley manoeuvre se ilaaj

rows.en: Sudden, constant vertigo for days, nausea, often after a viral illness; hearing normal
rows.ur: Achanak, musalsal chakkar kai din, matli, aksar viral bimari ke baad; sunna normal

rows.en: One-sided horizontal nystagmus; the HINTS exam separates it from stroke; vestibular rehabilitation later
rows.ur: Ek taraf horizontal nystagmus; HINTS exam use stroke se alag karta hai; baad mein vestibular rehabilitation

rows.en: Vertigo with headache, double vision, slurred speech, limb or facial weakness or numbness, severe unsteadiness
rows.ur: Chakkar ke saath sar dard, double vision, lukhnat, limb ya chehre ki kamzori ya sunnapan, shadeed larkharahat

rows.en: Down-beating or direction-changing nystagmus, cannot walk unaided: urgent medical referral
rows.ur: Neechay wala ya simt badalne wala nystagmus, baghair sahare chal nahi sakta: foran medical referral

title.en: Before you treat: a safe approach

steps.title: Take the story and screen for red flags
steps.detail: Triggers, duration, hearing loss, headache, neurological symptoms, neck problems, heart conditions. || Kahani lein aur red flags screen karein

steps.title: Explain what will happen
steps.detail: Warn that the test will bring the dizziness on briefly, that it is expected, and that you are in control. || Samjhayein kya hoga

steps.title: Test both ears with Dix-Hallpike
steps.detail: Keep the eyes in view, ideally without fixing on a target; note direction, delay, duration and fatigue. || Dono kaan Dix-Hallpike se test karein

steps.title: Treat only a typical positive test
steps.detail: Perform the Epley for the affected posterior canal; a horizontal-canal pattern (horizontal nystagmus on a supine roll test) needs a different manoeuvre. || Sirf typical positive test ka ilaaj karein

steps.title: Retest and give simple advice
steps.detail: Sit up, wait for the dizziness to clear, repeat the Dix-Hallpike (negative?), and explain that brief returns of dizziness can happen. || Dobara test aur saday mashware

text.en: **Treating the wrong thing.** The commonest errors are performing the Epley without a positive Dix-Hallpike, treating the wrong ear, or treating a central problem as BPPV. A positive test on one side and an assumption on the other, or any "BPPV" with new neurological signs, is how a stroke gets a head-turning manoeuvre. Another myth: that patients must sleep upright or wear a collar for days afterwards. Current guidelines do not support post-manoeuvre restrictions, and vestibular suppressant tablets should not be given as routine treatment for BPPV.
text.ur: **Ghalat cheez ka ilaaj.** Aam ghaltiyan: positive Dix-Hallpike ke baghair Epley karna, ghalat kaan ka ilaaj, ya central masle ko BPPV samajh kar ilaaj karna. Ek taraf positive test aur doosri taraf andaza, ya naye neurological signs ke saath koi bhi "BPPV", yoon ek stroke ko sar ghumane wali manoeuvre mil jati hai. Aik aur mithak: ke mareez ko baad mein seedha so kar ya collar pehen kar kai din rehna chahiye. Maujooda guidelines manoeuvre ke baad pabandiyon ko support nahi karti, aur vestibular suppressant goliyan BPPV ke aam ilaaj ke taur par nahi deni chahiye.

text.en: **Tell the patient the plan in one minute.** "Tiny crystals in your inner ear are in the wrong place. I am going to bring the dizziness on for a short while, then guide the crystals back with a set of head positions. You may feel dizzy for a few seconds, and a little unsteady afterwards. Most people are fixed after one to three sessions. It can come back, and if it does, come straight back; we can treat it again." Note in the record: affected ear, canal, test findings, manoeuvre done, response and the result of the retest.
text.ur: **Ek minute mein patient ko plan batayein.** "Aap ke andaruni kaan mein chhote crystals ghalat jagah par hain. Main thori der ke liye chakkar layunga, phir sar ki positions se crystals ko wapas laaunga. Kuch seconds chakkar aur baad mein thori larkharahat ho sakti hai. Zyada tar log ek se teen sessions mein theek ho jate hain. Yeh wapas aa sakta hai, aur aaye to seedha wapas aayein; hum phir ilaaj kar sakte hain." Record mein likhein: mutasir kaan, canal, test ke findings, kaunsi manoeuvre ki, response aur dobara test ka natija.

text.en: The American Academy of Otolaryngology guideline (2017) **recommends canalith repositioning** (Epley or a similar manoeuvre) as the treatment for posterior-canal BPPV, advises against routine imaging and against routine vestibular-suppressant drugs, and a Cochrane review found that the Epley manoeuvre is effective for posterior-canal BPPV compared with sham treatment. Recurrence is common over the years, so teach the patient to return early. Vestibular rehabilitation is added when there is persisting imbalance, not as a replacement for the repositioning.
text.ur: American Academy of Otolaryngology guideline (2017) posterior-canal BPPV ke ilaaj ke taur par **canalith repositioning** (Epley ya milti julti manoeuvre) ki **sifarish karti hai**, routine imaging aur routine vestibular-suppressant dawaiyon ke khilaf mashwara deti hai, aur Cochrane review mein sham ilaaj ke muqable mein posterior-canal BPPV ke liye Epley manoeuvre effective paya gaya. Salon mein recurrence aam hai, is liye mareez ko jaldi wapas aana sikhayein. Agar larkharahat qaim rahe to vestibular rehabilitation shamil karein, repositioning ke badle nahi.

text.en: **Stop and refer, do not treat, if:** nystagmus is down-beating, direction-changing, immediate or does not fade; any new weakness, numbness, double vision, slurred speech, severe headache or neck pain; vertigo after neck or head trauma; the patient cannot walk or sit unaided. **Take extra care or modify** for a painful or unstable neck (including rheumatoid arthritis and Down syndrome), severe back problems, unstable heart disease, or a patient who cannot lie back. Always keep one hand ready to steady the patient: a post-treatment fall is the real risk.
text.ur: **Ruk jayein aur refer karein, ilaaj na karein, agar:** nystagmus neechay wala, simt badalne wala, foran shuru hone wala ya khatam na hone wala ho; koi nayi kamzori, sunnapan, double vision, lukhnat, shadeed sar dard ya gardan dard; sar ya gardan ki chot ke baad chakkar; mareez baghair sahare chal ya baith na sake. **Ziyada ehtiyat ya tabdeeli karein:** dard wali ya ghair mustahkam gardan (rheumatoid arthritis aur Down syndrome samet), kamar ke shadeed masail, ghair mustahkam dil ki bimari, ya woh mareez jo peeche lait nahi sakta. Hamesha ek haath mareez ko sambhalne ke liye tayyar rakhein: ilaaj ke baad girna asal khatra hai.

prompt.en: BPPV or something else? Sort the clue.
prompt.ur: BPPV ya kuch aur? Ishara sort karein.

categories.ur: BPPV nahi: refer karein ya dobara sochein

text.en: Spinning for 20 seconds when rolling over in bed
text.ur: Bistar par palatne par 20 second chakkar

why.ur: Mukhtasar, position se trigger hone wala chakkar typical hai.

text.en: Upbeating-twisting nystagmus that starts after a delay and fades
text.ur: Upar jhatka aur ghoomta nystagmus jo delay ke baad shuru hota aur khatam ho jata hai

why.en: These are the textbook features of posterior-canal BPPV.
why.ur: Yeh posterior-canal BPPV ki kitabi alamaat hain.

text.en: Nystagmus that fatigues when the test is repeated
text.ur: Nystagmus jo test dohrane par thak jata hai

why.ur: Fatigability BPPV ki khaas alamat hai.

text.en: Down-beating nystagmus that does not fade
text.ur: Neechay wala nystagmus jo khatam nahi hota

text.en: Vertigo with facial numbness and double vision
text.ur: Chakkar ke saath chehre ka sunn hona aur double vision

question.en: Why does the vertigo fade within a minute, and why is the second test weaker?
question.ur: Chakkar ek minute mein kyun khatam hota hai aur doosra test kamzor kyun?

answer.en: The crystals roll to the lowest point of the canal and stop dragging the fluid, so the sensor springs back and the vertigo fades. A second test scatters the clump a little, so there are fewer crystals pushing and the response weakens. This **fatigability** is one of the features that tell BPPV apart from a central cause, which does not fade or fatigue.
answer.ur: Crystals canal ke sab se neechay point par pohanch kar fluid ko kheenchna band kar dete hain, to sensor wapas ho jata hai aur chakkar khatam. Doosra test clump ko thora bikher deta hai, is liye dhakelne wale crystals kam hotay hain aur response kamzor. Yeh **fatigability** un khasoosiyat mein se hai jo BPPV ko central wajah se alag karti hai, jo na khatam hoti hai na thakti hai.

question.en: What is the aim of the Epley manoeuvre?
question.ur: Epley manoeuvre ka maqsad kya hai?

text.en: To stretch the neck muscles that cause the dizziness
text.ur: Chakkar paida karne wale gardan ke muscles ko stretch karna

feedback.en: BPPV is an inner-ear problem. Neck stretching does not treat it.
feedback.ur: BPPV andaruni kaan ka masla hai. Gardan ki stretching iska ilaaj nahi.

text.en: To make the patient so dizzy that the brain gets used to it
text.ur: Mareez ko itna chakkar dilana ke dimagh aadi ho jaye

feedback.en: That describes habituation exercises, not the repositioning manoeuvre. The Epley aims to remove the cause.
feedback.ur: Yeh habituation mashqon ki baat hai, repositioning manoeuvre ki nahi. Epley ka maqsad wajah door karna hai.

text.en: To move the loose crystals out of the posterior canal back into the utricle, using gravity and head positions
text.ur: Dheelay crystals ko gravity aur sar ki positions se posterior canal se nikal kar wapas utricle mein pohanchana

feedback.en: Yes — the sequence of positions rolls the crystals round the canal and out through its opening.
feedback.ur: Haan — positions ki tarteeb crystals ko canal mein ghuma kar uske darwazay se bahar nikalti hai.

summary.en: BPPV is loose crystals in a canal (usually the posterior): brief, position-triggered vertigo with nothing in between.
summary.ur: BPPV canal (aam taur par posterior) mein dheelay crystals hain: mukhtasar, position se trigger hone wala chakkar aur beech mein kuch nahi.

summary.en: A positive Dix-Hallpike gives an upbeating-torsional nystagmus with delay and fatigue; the Epley's five positions roll the crystals out through the canal's opening.
summary.ur: Positive Dix-Hallpike delay aur fatigue ke saath upar jhatka aur ghoomta nystagmus deta hai; Epley ki paanch positions crystals ko canal ke darwazay se bahar ghumati hain.

summary.en: Down-beating or non-fading nystagmus, or any new neurological sign, means a central cause: stop and refer.
summary.ur: Neechay wala ya na khatam hone wala nystagmus, ya koi nayi neurological alamat central wajah hai: ruk jayein aur refer karein.

back.en: Loose otoconia (calcium crystals) in a semicircular canal, usually the posterior one, causing brief position-triggered vertigo.
back.ur: Semicircular canal (aam taur par posterior) mein dheelay otoconia (calcium crystals), jo mukhtasar position se trigger hone wala chakkar deta hain.

front.en: What is a positive Dix-Hallpike for the posterior canal?
front.ur: Posterior canal ke liye positive Dix-Hallpike kya hai?

back.en: Vertigo plus upbeating-torsional nystagmus after a short delay, lasting under a minute and fatiguing on repetition.
back.ur: Chakkar aur thori der baad upar jhatka aur ghoomta nystagmus, ek minute se kam, dohrane par thak jata hai.

front.en: Give the five steps of the Epley manoeuvre.
front.ur: Epley manoeuvre ke paanch qadam batayein.

back.en: Sit with the head 45° to the affected side; lie back head-hanging; turn the head 90° to the other side; roll the body to nose-down 45°; sit up. Hold each 30–60 s.
back.ur: Mutasir side par sar 45° ke saath baithein; sar latka kar litayein; sar 90° doosri side ghumayein; jism karwat se naak 45° neechay; uth baithein. Har position 30–60 s.

front.en: Which findings mean a central cause, not BPPV?
front.ur: Kaunsi findings central wajah dikhati hain, BPPV nahi?

back.en: Down-beating or direction-changing nystagmus, no delay, no fading, or new neurological signs or inability to walk.
back.ur: Neechay wala ya simt badalne wala nystagmus, delay nahi, khatam nahi hota, ya nayi neurological alamat ya chal na sakna.

note.ur: BPPV aur vestibular masail ke liye mukammal guide.

note.en: After the crystals are cleared, check balance and falls risk.
note.ur: Crystals saaf hone ke baad balance aur girne ka khatra dekhein.

note.en: When dizziness is a medical emergency.
